subject: general
question: Genes control traits through the activity of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**hormones**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​**Hormones**

 
 
• **Genes control traits through the activity of hormones.**
 
• The** pituitary** stalk connects the **hypothalamus**, a tiny portion of the brain, to the **pituitary gland.**
 
• Your pituitary gland is regulated by a number of hormones that are released.
 
• **Peptide hormones,** which are soluble in water, are made up of **amino acids**.
 
• In contrast to peptide hormones, **steroid hormones **can pass through **cell membranes and are fat-soluble.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Genes**

 
 
• **A gene is the primary structural and functional element of heredity.**
 
• **DNA** is the component of genes. 
 
• Most genes result in individual proteins or subsets of proteins, each of which serves a unique purpose in the body.
 
• There are about **20,000 protein-coding genes in humans.**
